say:3:1061302002:1.text: Ha! No one can resist a round of Century Quest!
say:3:1061302002:1.source_cn: 哈哈，我就知道，没有人能拒绝百物牌的魅力！
say:3:1061302002:1.male: Ha! No one can resist a round of Century Quest!
say:3:1061302002:1.female: Ha! No one can resist a round of Century Quest!

say:4:1061302004:1.text: It's my turn to play, but since I'm nice and you're new. I'll let you have a go.
say:4:1061302004:1.source_cn: 算你运气好，这一局刚好轮到我来玩，看在你是新面孔的份上...
say:4:1061302004:1.male: It's my turn to play, but since I'm nice and you're new. I'll let you have a go.
say:4:1061302004:1.female: It's my turn to play, but since I'm nice and you're new. I'll let you have a go.

say:5:1061302005:1.text: None of the other guys are this nice.
say:5:1061302005:1.source_cn: 要是换成旁边这几个家伙，他们才不会让给你呢！
say:5:1061302005:1.male: None of the other guys are this nice.
say:5:1061302005:1.female: None of the other guys are this nice.

say:6:1061302006:1.text: Get ready, and don't let me down.
say:6:1061302006:1.source_cn: 做好准备，可别让我失望啊。
say:6:1061302006:1.male: Get ready, and don't let me down.
say:6:1061302006:1.female: Get ready, and don't let me down.

say:8:1061302003:1.text: Don't be shy. We're all here to play Century Quest!
say:8:1061302003:1.source_cn: 不用害羞，你看这里有这么多人呢，大家都是牌友嘛！
say:8:1061302003:1.male: Don't be shy. We're all here to play Century Quest!
say:8:1061302003:1.female: Don't be shy. We're all here to play Century Quest!
